page_title: GEN 0-2 UDI | Genoa v Udinese 20/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' 0 - 2 Goal! Keinan Davis (Udinese) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 0:2.
90+5' Amorim (Genoa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+4' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Oier Zarraga.
90+2' Lennon Miller (Udinese) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+2' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Oumar Solet (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
87' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is replaced by Lennon Miller (Udinese).
87' Kingsley Ehizibue comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolo Bertola (Udinese).
84' Although Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) is just on the bench, Giuseppe Collu has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
84' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Morten Frendrup will be replaced by Amorim (Genoa).
84' It's time for a substitution. Aaron Martin (Genoa) comes on in place of Johan Vasquez.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hassane Kamara leaves the pitch and Juan Arizala (Udinese) comes on.
83' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) commits a foul and Giuseppe Collu immediately signals a free kick.
81' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
81' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but Maduka Okoye is equal to it and makes an easy save. Now Genoa have a corner.

79' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
76' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
72' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) replaces Lorenzo Colombo.
72' Substitution. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) in, Vitinha out.
71' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' 0 - 1 Goal! Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Nicolo Zaniolo and easily beat the keeper with a header into the middle of the goal from close range. 0:1.
64' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giuseppe Collu had an easy-decision to make.
63' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) steps up to send the ball in.
60' Here is a change. Junior Messias is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa).
58' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' A player from Udinese commits a rough challenge. Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
53' The Genoa players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Giuseppe Collu. NO PENALTY!
50' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Genoa as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
49' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) touches the ball with his hand. Genoa are awarded a penalty kick!
48' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
48' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

47' Junior Messias (Genoa) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Maduka Okoye thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Genoa have a corner.
46' Kosta Runjaic makes a switch. Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) is coming on in place of Arthur Atta at the start of the second period.
46' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The corner finds Christian Kabasele (Udinese) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
44' Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
41' Vitinha (Genoa) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.

39' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
37' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from inside the penalty area straight onto the crossbar!
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Genoa. The ball possession is 61:39.
35' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
33' Giuseppe Collu interrupts the game. One of the players from Udinese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
30' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
28' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.

26' This should have been a goal! Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.
24' It must be a yellow card. It is. Hassane Kamara (Udinese) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
23' It looks like Christian Kabasele (Udinese) saw red with that tackle. Giuseppe Collu won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
22' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is able to continue to play.
22' Looks like Oumar Solet (Udinese) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
18' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman signals a throw-in for Genoa.
16' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul after Hassane Kamara (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
7' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
5' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Udinese will kick the game off.
Giuseppe Collu is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
